question: road name start point lon lat
sql: SELECT names."primary" AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 5) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names."primary" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5

question: footway wkt
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 3

question: steps geojson
sql: SELECT COALESCE(names."primary", '(unnamed)') AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'steps' LIMIT 5

question: residential speed limit kmh
sql: SELECT COALESCE(names."primary", '(unnamed)') AS name, CAST(speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || speed_limits[1].max_speed.unit AS speed_limit FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND speed_limits[1].max_speed.value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5

question: tertiary roads bbox
sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(ST_XMin(geometry)), 4) AS west, ROUND(MIN(ST_YMin(geometry)), 4) AS south, ROUND(MAX(ST_XMax(geometry)), 4) AS east, ROUND(MAX(ST_YMax(geometry)), 4) AS north FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary'

question: crosswalk centroid formatted
sql: SELECT COALESCE(names."primary", '(unnamed)') AS name, format('{:.5f}, {:.5f}', ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)), ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry))) AS lonlat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'crosswalk' LIMIT 5
